visualCharacteristics.purpose: Solution category pages (by market, by role): a grid of linked category cards, one per detail page
visualCharacteristics.layout: Image on top, small H4 title, description below; no CTA. Three cards per row from 768px, wrapping for any count; stacked full width below 768px (no carousel). The whole card is clickable via the title link
visualCharacteristics.sourceSection: Category Cards (solutions/by-market.html .columnselector rows), on a light-grey section

contentPattern.structure: one row per card (any count): cell 1 card image (optionally linked); cell 2 heading (H4) linked to the detail page, description paragraph. The heading link (or the first link in the card) becomes the whole-card link

usage: Solution category pages listing their detail pages as image cards with a short description (5 cards on by-market, 8 on by-role).
reuseGuidance: Use for an image-top, no-CTA, 3-up wrapping grid of linked cards. For cards with a two-line heading and 'Go Now' CTA (or the related-products carousel) use cards-solutions; for full-width horizontal tiles use cards-hub-tiles; for icon + label quick links use cards-icon-links.
